parts.t: Charming single-family home with 3 BEDS/ 1 BATH, fenced yard and alley-way access. Perfect for first-time buyers or a strong rental investment. Currently rented for $2,000/month, this property delivers immediate income and solid rental potential. Located just minutes from parks, a dedicated dog park, scenic walking and biking trails, and the shops and dining of downtown Princeton—combining convenient outdoor recreation with easy access to local amenities. Contact today to set up a viewing!

v: Functional layout with 3 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom. Bright living spaces and practical floorplan ideal for everyday living or rental use.
Fully fenced yard with alley access, offering additional parking flexibility and outdoor space for pets or entertaining.
Currently tenant-occupied generating $2,000/month, making this a strong income property with immediate cash flow.
Close to parks, dog park, walking and biking trails, and minutes to downtown Princeton shops, dining, and services.
